start: MettleUp Plus, a workout open on the phone, the MettleUp watch app showing the workout

user_sees: The phone ticks that set, the rest starts on phone and watch, the phone shows the rest card
must_not: A different set ticked than the watch named

user_sees: The set ticked with the watch's numbers
must_not: Numbers changed from what the watch showed

start: A rest running, shown on the watch countdown

user_sees: The phone card and the app timer move 15 s later
must_not: Watch and phone showing different end times

user_sees: The rest ends 15 s sooner, never less than a second from now
must_not: A rest ending in the past and no alert

user_sees: The rest goes on phone and watch; the live workout card comes back on the phone
must_not: A 'Rest is over' later for the skipped rest

start: A rest running, the watch countdown showing 'Done'

user_sees: The set the countdown names is ticked on the phone
must_not: The tap lost with no sign on the watch

start: The watch sends a Done the phone cannot read (an older or broken message)

user_sees: The watch shows its button again at once with a note that it was not logged
must_not: The watch hiding the button for 20 s as if the set were saved

steps.action: Tap '−15' after the rest already ended

start: MettleUp swiped away on the phone, workout open, watch connected

user_sees: The phone starts the rest itself, or shows 'Open MettleUp to save ...' when it cannot tick the set alone
must_not: The tap ignored silently while the watch thinks it was saved
The tick applied twice or lost

start: A phone paired with a watch

steps.action: Consider who can send these buttons
user_sees: Only the MettleUp watch app (same package and signing key) can send them to the phone
must_not: Another app on the watch able to tick sets or skip rests
Watch buttons working on the free plan where the watch app is a Plus feature
